bullets.text: In Taramani, 150 families reside in a dangerous, uninhabitable Urban Development Board tenement that risks collapsing at any moment.
Thiruvallur municipal sewage is flowing into the Cooum River, threatening Chennai drinking water sources like the Chembarambakkam lake.
The Southern Railway has urged the Chief Secretary to relocate 43 Tasmac liquor shops near railway tracks due to safety hazards and harassment.
Adambakkam MRTS station remains closed seven months after opening due to design flaws, denying proper transit access to local residents.
Taramani police arrested a man for allegedly recording a female IT employee while she was bathing in a hostel.
Avadi police arrested a Village Administrative Officer and his assistant for demanding an 8,000 rupee bribe to issue a legal heir certificate.
Collector S. Kavitha inspected direct paddy procurement operations and crop survey assessments at the Perakuppam center near Tiruttani.
Poonamallee police registered a case after a person was killed by a speeding bike while trying to cross the national highway near Gummidipoondi.
Google India has secured clearance for a 2.51GW power capacity to support its upcoming AI hub operations in the country.
Starbucks is establishing its first India Global Capability Centre in Chennai, creating 800 new jobs for the region.
The Greater Chennai Corporation has allocated a 98.25 crore rupee plan to upgrade its Integrated Command and Control Centre with more flood monitors.
The TVK government led by Chief Minister Vijay rolled back several key policy announcements following public pushback and opposition.
Minister Raj Mohan stated that merely changing the election commissioner would not serve as a permanent solution to electoral issues.
The Tamil Nadu government has launched a new welfare scheme to present gold rings to newborns in Chennai government hospitals.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate the first corridor service of the Chennai Metro Phase II project on October 11.
